error_clusters.name: High Lexical Overlap Chimera with Appended Refutation Clause
error_clusters.claim_pattern: {Source_Prefix_Sentence_Fragment} was completely refuted and disproven by external peer reviews.
error_clusters.root_cause: The claim copies 12 tokens verbatim from the source premise ('Asset Manager AM-5 released fiscal audit report #5, reporting total assets under'), achieving >= 80% lexical token overlap before structured rejection of the tail refutation predicate. The neural cross-encoder fallback assigned probability 0.89 due to the heavy leading token overlap.
error_clusters.remediation_strategy: Incorporate explicit negative predicate detection for trailing ungrounded refutation clauses ('refuted and disproven', 'contradicted by external') in the structured lexical overlap calculator to reject chimera sentences before computing overlap percentages.
